release_notes: **Assign & Save** in the Barcode Generator now saves in the background — the button shows it's working and the app stays fully usable, even for hundreds of barcodes.; **Changing colours** (the colour popup in the matrix, and in Part Types: the model include/exclude checkboxes, colour dialogs, adding/removing part-type colours, and Save-all-barcodes) used to send **one cloud request per part type × colour** — hundreds of round-trips that froze the app for many seconds. These now run as a few combined requests **in the background**: click Save and keep working; the view refreshes when it's done.
